verdict.rationale: The Privacy & Cyber practice page generically claims 'full-spectrum legal support...to solve today's complex and dynamic compliance, regulatory, litigation, and transactional challenges,' which implies breach/regulatory work falls within scope, but no page explicitly names security-incident response, breach notification, or regulator-facing breach work. Missing for 10: explicit breach-response service description, incident-response case studies/deal highlights, and named regulator-facing engagement examples.
